description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models in a streaming environment. The vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLama, and Claude. The chart features two sets of bars, each representing a different model type: "Our Joint Framework" is depicted with green bars, while "LLM Models" are shown in sky blue. The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds, which is the shortest among the models. The "LLM Models" have varying runtimes, with "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLama" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 243 seconds. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which helps to distinguish between the two model types. The chart is saved as a high-resolution JPEG image named "8-3918.jpg".
